labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports unexpected test failures with a newer Pygments; reads as a bug, pending a reproduction.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example, Rich version or diagnose output provided.

body:
To help us look into this, please add the following:

1. A minimal runnable example: the smallest script that shows the failing Rich output. If the tests are what fails, name the failing test and paste only its first failure, since full diffs are long. You can also attach a file.
2. Your Rich version and environment. Please paste the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`.
3. The Pygments version you tested with (2.21.0 in this report) and your Python version.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
